feed.title: Re: Safer sighashes and more granular SIGHASH_NOINPUT

entry.title: Re: Safer sighashes and more granular SIGHASH_NOINPUT
entry.summary:
Signing the full script or masked script without truncation ensures that OP_CODESEPARATOR remains both usable and secure when combined with NOINPUT. Under the new sighash proposal, committing to the hash of the entire script means that the exact position of the last executed OP_CODESEPARATOR will also be included in the signature process. This approach maintains the intended functionality of OP_CODESEPARATOR by allowing its position to be reliably committed within the transaction.
If NOINPUT fails to commit to the masked script, the commitment to the OP_CODESEPARATOR position becomes arbitrary. Consequently, wallets would not have clarity regarding which parts of the script are actually being executed, undermining transaction security and predictability. Proper commitment to the script and OP_CODESEPARATOR position is essential for ensuring reliable operation and safeguarding against unintended behaviors in wallet implementations.
